hero.headline: The AI workspace for rights and royalty teams.
hero.subhead: Connect your contracts, catalogue data, statements and existing royalty systems. Debaser finds the errors, explains the payments, and helps your team recover what's missing.
hero.note: Works with the royalty systems you already use.

problem.headline: Royalty systems calculate what they receive. They don't tell you what's missing, or wrong.

items.title: Catalogue data doesn't agree with itself.
Investigations happen in spreadsheets, inboxes and people's heads.

problem.closingLine: That means slow answers, repeated work and income left unclaimed.

productFlow.headline: Debaser sits above the royalty stack you already run.
productFlow.subhead: Keep Curve, Vistex, Counterpoint, spreadsheets or your own platform as the system of record. Debaser connects the data around it, investigates the result, and turns findings into action.

steps.label: Connect
steps.description: Bring in contracts, catalogue data, statements and exports from any system.

steps.label: Match
steps.description: Link income to works, recordings, parties and agreements.

steps.label: Investigate
steps.description: Find unmatched income, conflicts, missing statements and unusual changes.

steps.label: Explain
steps.description: Trace each answer to the exact row, clause or source file.

steps.label: Resolve
steps.description: Prepare corrections, claims and tasks for approval.

agents.headline: Specialist agents for royalty operations.

items.name: Ingestion Agent
items.description: Maps files and exports into a common royalty schema.

items.name: Contract Agent
items.description: Reads rates, splits, deductions, recoupment and exceptions.

items.name: Matching Agent
items.description: Links income to the correct works, recordings and parties.

items.name: Exception Agent
items.description: Finds gaps, conflicts, duplicates and unusual changes.

items.name: Audit Agent
items.description: Compares expected and received income, then builds the evidence.

items.name: Ops Agent
items.description: Turns findings into a prioritised queue for review and action.

agents.note: The agents share context through Debaser's rights graph.

useCases.headline: Built for the teams behind the catalogue.

items.headline: Check royalty runs before statements go out.
items.description: Find catalogue and contract issues early.

missingMoney.headline: Find the money that never reached the statement.
missingMoney.subhead: Debaser compares catalogue expectations, source data and received statements, and shows you exactly where they don't line up.
features: Evidence needed to raise a claim.

explainability.headline: Ask a royalty question. Get an answer you can verify.
explainability.body1: Ask why a royalty amount changed, and Debaser traces the answer back to the source rows, the catalogue metadata, the contract terms.
explainability.body2: Not a summary. Not a hallucination. A structured answer with direct references to the evidence, so your team can verify, audit and act.
explainability.chatUserMessage: Why did this artist earn less this quarter?
explainability.chatAiResponse: Spotify UK income fell 31% against Q1. Two recordings were not matched because their ISRCs were missing, leaving an estimated £3,100 unattributed. The producer deduction was also applied before the recoupment threshold. This conflicts with clause 4.2(b) of the recording agreement.

trust.headline: Built for sensitive rights data.
trust.subhead: Royalty data is some of the most commercially sensitive information in the music industry. We treat it accordingly.

vision.headline: A straight line from every play to the rights holder it belongs to.
vision.body1: Debaser is AI layer above your royalty systems and will become the shared rights and contract layer, running royalty workflows, connecting usage data and supporting direct claims and collection.
vision.body2: Future usage data may come from platforms, partners and venue sensors. A song plays. Debaser identifies it, resolves the rights, supports the claim and tracks the payment.
vision.graphCaption: Songs → Recordings → Contracts → Income → Ownership → Usage
